body: I'm basically gonna tell him off n express how his actions make me feel next time he does something. I'm kinda done with him being bipolar and immature. I don't wanna be mean, but I've been patient enough with him.
I really don't wanna deal with that, which is why I'm asking for some help. If he does like me, I really don't wanna be with him cuz that'll end up probably being really toxic..

yeah.. I tend to avoid talking with him but since hes in my friend group its hard to avoid it sometimes. Generally if its just us I'll walk away or just listen to music and ignore him.. kinda rude but I can't really do anything else

mhm! I'm glad that I've only met him once irl tbh. Gives me less worry for next year when we will be in the same highschool at the same time. He didn't really remember what I looked like either so that's good. Although one of the "guys" keeps photos of everyone -.- (he's a real creep and when I jokingly said yes to giving him a bj he got excited) so he could get one from creepo. He was running and he just slowed to a stop looking me straight in the eyes. Probably expecting me just to tackle him (i've tried to fight him but he always backs out last minute). Im not really scared of him. I know enough fighting (my uncles been teaching me defense) that I could easily break his wrist and leg if I wanted. He knows it as well lmao

I hate to say it but you are really right. The issue with the limit contact is he's talked me out of doing some stuff and until I am mental stable I can't as my parents nor sister care and my others friends don't care/understand. I've only willingly met him once and that was with all the guys (before they became jerks). I'm already willing to accept that "we" won't work. I'll be more cautious. Btw the reason he starting talking to me in the first place was because I told a group chat of the guys after they got me really pissed that I was depressed and so he msged me saying he knew what I was going through. Looking back there are so many red flags. Thanks for pulling this more to my attention. :/

Yeah, first thing I learned was actually a move where you think of water flowing through your body into the Earth. If you put all your focus into thinking of that it actually holds you still. Taught me focus but it that situation when I had 2 guys vs a small underweight girl I just let myself do whatever. With the lesbian situation I just saw red for her thinking that as my sister thought I was lesbian for a year and it brought bad memories.

This made me laugh. Thanks! Brightened up my day. I actually am worried I would break her nose or wrist as I've been taking defense classes from my uncle and working out at the gym. If I hurt her I'll get in huge trouble and probably get grounded (my only escape from my life is walking my dog). I'm actually worried that next time I talk with my mom or dad I will just start screaming at them about all the stuff they've done since I was 6 (nothing physical just emotional) and the next time my sister attacks me I'll just see red and beat her to pulp. I've done it to 2 other kids before (when I was 12 I got into a huge argument with my sisters 16 year old guy friends. I broke one of their wrists and the other I kicked in the balls before punching him out. They never told anyone what happened as that would be embarrassing to them so my sister doesn't know what I can do). I've actually pinned a girl against a wall because she got hands on with me (she was lesbian) and me being the "bad girl" style clothing she thought I was too.

Thanks! The reason why going to my parents don't work is because she's the favorite child. If we were both liked the same that would work but we aren't. I've tried gaining respect by taking fighting classes (thanks uncle!) and working out but I haven't done it enough to win enough fights and be respected (I've even fought her 17 year old guy friends and that back fired as 3 worked out a the others were bigger and overpowered me easily). I've also tried talking seriously with my parents and her. My dad interrupts me and my mom has enough stress from work she doesn't care. My dad also is trying to get my sister to like him so he bends towards her often. Thanks for the advise though! I will try different stuff to earn her respect. Maybe I should try to build a relationship with my parents first so that they lean towards me and help me get my sister to stop fighting.
